name: Finish sampler
blurb: One board with four finishes side by side, so you can see what each one looks like on real wood.

steps.text: Sand it smooth on the top and the edges.
Draw lines across the board every 4 inches to make four boxes, and write a finish name under each box.
Box 1: leave it bare so you can see the plain wood.
Box 2: wipe on water-based finish with a rag. Let it dry 2 hours and add a second coat.
Box 3: wipe on food-safe mineral oil. Wipe off the extra after 15 minutes.
Box 4: brush on a thin coat of shellac. A grown-up helps — it smells strong.
When everything is dry, rub paste wax on half of each box and buff it. Which do you like best?
